services.desc: Wednesdays 4-5 PM - Ages 6-16. Real boxing skills, zero pressure - confidence, coordination, and a whole lot of fun on Seattle's most welcoming gym floor. Cappy's youth program uses boxing and movement to build skills kids carry far outside the gym. Every session is age-appropriate and adapted to different experience levels, abilities, and group needs. Every family chooses how far to take it. Kids can train fully non-contact and still get everything out of the program - and those who want to test themselves can work up to controlled contact and sparring under close coach supervision. services.name: Teen Summer Camp
services.desc: This summer, give your teen the opportunity to grow stronger - inside and out - at Cappy’s Summer Boxing Camp. Designed for ages 13-17, our camp blends real boxing fundamentals with confidence-building, teamwork, and tons of fun. Each day starts in the gym where campers learn proper hand wrapping, boxing fundamentals, footwork, defense, mitt work, partner drills, and conditioning in a structured, supportive environment. In the afternoons, we head outside for lunch, team challenges, and skill-building activities that reinforce discipline, leadership, and resilience.
